title.hr: Tko o čemu odlučuje: hijerarhija na setu
title.en: Who decides what: the chain of command on set

concept.hr: Zahtjev ide kroz šefa odjela i 1st AD-a, ne ravno tuđoj ekipi
concept.en: Requests go through the head of department and the 1st AD

summary.hr: Pošalji zahtjeve preko seta najbližemu ili kroz šefa odjela i 1st AD-a: tko mora reći da, izgubljeni zahtjevi, dva naloga i vrijeme do odgovora.
summary.en: Send requests across the set to the nearest person or through the head and the 1st AD: who must say yes, lost requests, two orders, time to answer.

concept.hr: Pet zahtjeva najbližemu: tri izgubljena, dva bez odobrenja, dvoje s dva naloga
concept.en: To the nearest: three lost, two done without a yes, two people with two orders

concept.hr: Isti zahtjevi kroz šefa i 1st AD-a: svih pet odgovoreno, prosječno 3,4 minute
concept.en: Through the head and the 1st AD: all five answered, 3.4 minutes on average

concept.hr: Sigurnost ide ravno 1st AD-u, koji zove key gripa: stativ je van za 3 minute
concept.en: Safety goes straight to the 1st AD, who calls the key grip: out in 3 minutes
